# ankerl::unordered_dense

This directory vendors `ankerl::unordered_dense` v4.8.1 from:

https://github.com/martinus/unordered_dense

The dependency is header-only and MIT licensed. DVSTOR includes it from
`thirdparty/ankerl`, so compute nodes and storage nodes do not need a system
package, Conda package, or machine-specific include/library path. Syncing this
repository and rebuilding is sufficient.

Vendored files:

- `unordered_dense.h`
- `stl.h`
